scope: Exact lossless storage adapter only; no clinical/replay expectation changes

edits.before: for(const f of m.files){const p=path.join(root,base,f.path);assert.equal(fs.statSync(p).size,f.bytes,'Archived size '+f.path);assert.equal(sha(p),f.sha256,'Archived source/review '+f.path);}
edits.after: for(const f of m.files){const bytes=evidenceBytes(root,f.path);assert.equal(bytes.length,f.bytes,'Archived raw size '+f.path);assert.equal(crypto.createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex'),f.sha256,'Archived raw source/review '+f.path);}
